about: Dummy by Portishead, release group 48140466-cff6-3222-bd55-63c27e43190d, as MusicBrainz answered /release?release-group=...&inc=media+recordings+labels+artist-credits on 2026-09-30 - trimmed to the fields deadwax reads. Twenty pressings: twelve with the eleven-track tracklist, the ten-track CDs without "It's a Fire", the vinyl ~10s short on every track (Biscuit 30s - another version), and two with a twelfth track. 'expected' is what interface/scripts/tracklistDiff.mjs answered; ui/test/tracklist.sim.cjs holds it and the TypeScript port (ui/src/lib/tracklistDiff.ts) to it.
